items.title: Crypto Insolvency Advisory — May 29, 2026
items.summary: The FTX Recovery Trust commences its fifth distribution and first preferred-equity payment on May 29, and moves to cut the disputed-claims reserve by $600M from $2.4B to $1.8B — read against the broader 2022–23 insolvency wave spanning Genesis/DCG, Celsius, Prime Trust, and BlockFills.

items.title: From Refund Right to Cash in Hand: How Importers File and Sell an IEEPA Tariff Claim
items.summary: This guide is for every IEEPA refund rights holder considering a sale of their claim.

items.title: Bartz Second Installment Due Tomorrow; Fairness Hearing Confirmed for May 14
items.summary: Anthropic's second $300M installment is due April 30, bringing the funded total to $600M of the $1.5B settlement. Authors Alliance publishes unsealed-objection analysis as the May 14 fairness hearing approaches. CCIA, AI Progress, and NetChoice file Concord amicus; OpenAI's 20M-log production order continues to reshape AI copyright discovery; CJEU holds first-ever generative-AI hearing in Like Company v. Google.

items.title: Forty-Eight Hours to Bartz: Settlement Funding, Fairness-Hearing Stakes, and the Concord Cross-Motion
items.summary: With the second $300M installment due in 48 hours, the Bartz settlement approaches its most consequential week since preliminary approval. We map the inflection points across Bartz, Concord (Anthropic cross-MSJ filed April 22), and the broader docket.

items.title: Bartz Settlement Enters Its Most Consequential Week
items.summary: Anthropic's second $300M installment is now four days out on April 30, and the Bartz v. Anthropic settlement enters its most consequential week since preliminary approval. We trace the implications for class members, opt-outs, and parallel music-publisher matters.

items.title: Anthropic's Concord Cross-Motion: The Most Consequential Fair-Use Motion in AI Music Copyright
items.summary: Anthropic's cross-motion for summary judgment in Concord Music Group v. Anthropic, filed April 22, is the most consequential fair-use motion in any AI music copyright case to date. We unpack the doctrinal stakes for §107 analysis and the parallel publisher docket.

items.title: Bartz Fairness Hearing Rescheduled; Unsealed Objections Reach the Docket
items.summary: What was to be the day of reckoning for the largest copyright settlement in American history shifted under Judge Martínez-Olguín's April 8 order. We catalogue the unsealed objections — publisher favoritism, group-registration collapse, and statutory-damages adequacy — and what each may mean at the May 14 hearing.
